## Procedure

1. Keep core engaged and back parallel to the ground
2. Raise both dumbbells laterally from the shoulders until they are at shoulder level (-20)
3. Slowly lower dumbbells to start position in a controlled motion

## Coaching Points

- Keep the back parallel to the ground and maintain a flat back throughout the lift
- Avoid using momentum to complete the lift
- Concentrate on raising the dumbbells laterally from the shoulders

## 3b. Barbell Standing Behind the Neck Shoulder Press

Exercise Objective: Develop strength in the muscles of the shoulder girdle and teach the athlete to use the whole body to stabilize overhead loads
